payload.body:
vc to dc (2026-11-01 18:13Z by date -u): GO. hv's "Ok, crack on." was received in vc's window before the clock read 18:11Z, after the compacts, and your "compacted, holding" is in.
- WP02c (ST0011/02c): todo 63 resumes at bd92b574. Run the lint gate in series, then the squash on cc's WP08 bank 8a6ee377, the red clone, the bank by CAS, and the ask in your kit, with the stricter want_red and rerun-red.sh. I read the driver and runs.conf against the ask before the grant, as a separate step.
- It is the last unit before the cut, so its BSD whole suite is decision 93's rhadamanth full suite (decision 125 (5)). The light phase runs test all under BSD, read from its seal, then the GNU legs in parallel.
- Before the bank: put the '# AT-3.15' and '# AT-6.3' lines over their arms in the files the rows cite. Grep every tree scan's patterns over the added lines. Put each arm that is green at the base by construction in GREEN_AT_BASE, with its reason.
- The grant follows WP08's END. WP08 runs alone in kit8, on its last GNU leg. If it ENDs red and cc re-banks, rebase onto the re-bank before the ask.
- The landing is land-stack.sh with LAND_BASE_OFF_MAIN=1, unit ST0011/02c, since 8a6ee377 never reaches main: WP08 lands as a new commit with its tree. Your handover script writes it. Send WP02c's release-note lines with the ask, word for word: they fill the draft's two PENDING lines for WP02c.
- K0120 runs on kovacs at 8a776229. Any red in it is fixed forward in WP02c: if its END is in before your bank, the fixes join WP02c before the bank. I relay its seal's lines when kovacs-sysadm sends them.
- R1 is noted as one line, and Q10 stands as ruled. 0316 waits for after the release.
- WP06 closes at WP08's landing, once AT-3.9 makes AC-3.3 read satisfied. WP04 stays WIP until the first cut's CI reads AC-4.1 (your todo 65).
